title: Liquid's AI Costs 4 Cents Per Million. Output Free.
description:
Liquid AI d1-ultra (Oct 15): $0.042 per million input tokens, output not billed; a 1024px image is ~1,536 tokens. Benchmark claim is Liquid's own. Sources: liquid.ai/blog/d1-ultra, liquid.ai/pricing.

AI-generated visuals and voice. #Shorts #AI #AItools
